steps.caption: Start. Today says where each project stands, in words, with one button per row.
Answer opens the one Inbox on that question. Its number counts only what needs you.
Focus. One project at a time. The others show a dot only when something waits.
The sidebar, tabs and panes now belong to this project. Each project keeps its place.
Work: the project's tasks in flight, then every worktree of its folder, with who is in it.
⇧⌘N: one box to start work. What to do, where, and who, or no agent for a bare worktree.

click.selector: role=navigation[name="Resume"] >> role=button[name=/Write the pricing page copy/]

steps.caption: Resume leads with the task that asks a question. The question is on its card.
Review mode: the report at reading width, the brief folded, one bar for Send, Accept and Done.
Answer on the card. The question leaves the Inbox too, and its number drops.
⌘1 is everything again, where you left it.
Search reads inside pages. A half-remembered phrase finds the line.
Enter opens the page at that paragraph.
Reading. Today remembers what you noted. The page opens beside, with one line above its title.
Recall shows your notes one at a time and asks for your own words.
Enter saves the line as a sidenote. The page itself is untouched.
Shutdown. What you captured waits in the same Inbox. File it, or leave it for tomorrow.
One door, one project, one press.
